$comment: Pin for oxagen's Stella sidecar transport. The smoke test in src/stella-serve.smoke.test.ts boots exactly this stella version's `stella-serve` binary and drives a full multi-step turn through it. Bump stellaVersion deliberately, in its own commit, when upgrading — stella releases daily and this file is the only place oxagen records which release it has verified the wire contract against. A version MISMATCH does not skip the test. The smoke test's assertions are themselves the drift detector, so running against an unpinned build is how drift gets caught. Only a missing binary skips.
